definition: Michael Bronstein (Hebrew: מיכאל ברונשטיין; Russian: Михаил Бронштейн; born 1980) is a British and Israeli computer scientist and entrepreneur.
details: He is a computer science professor at the University of Oxford holding the DeepMind Chair in Artificial Intelligence and founding Scientific Director of Aithyra Institute at the Vienna Biocenter in Austria.
story: Imagine an art restorer who can spot a single cracked tile in a vast mosaic. What your eyes do without thinking, the machine does one careful layer at a time. The machine learns to see the way we do — starting with shapes and edges, then building up to whole objects and faces. The model looks the way you look at a crowd and finds the one face you know. And that is Michael Bronstein — giving a machine the gift of sight.
